Name: Additional Mini Farm - Scenic Edition
Author: stardewmoddingteen
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]Having space issues on your farm? This mod adds a bit more farmland so you can plant more crops and place more buildings! Everyone can now enjoy this fair and balanced mod! [/color]

[color=#999999]This version of the original mod makes the mini farm more lively with a waterfall and river, along with an apple tree. You can also fish up trash, and interact with the shrouded figure.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]After unzipping the mod, place the folder named 'Additional Mini Farm - Scenic Edition' into your mods folder, and you can start playing! [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]- More farmland on a seperate plot accessible from the Backwoods.
- River where you can fish up trash.
- Two foragable bushes are found in the plot.[/color]
[color=#999999]- A fully-grown apple tree allows for some foraging :D[/color]
[color=#999999]- Interact with the shrouded figure for some dialogue![/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]The SMAPI mod and the Content Patcher mod are required for this mod. [/color]

[b][color=#ffffff][size=4]Disclaimer[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#999999]This mod has not been tested with other mods. While it should work fine on its own, using it alongside additional mods is at your own risk. Please backup your saves before using the mod if you are using additional mods. If you find that some mods are not functioning with this mod, please let me know through the 'post' section for this mod.[/color]

[b][size=4]Shoutouts[/size][/b]
A huge thank you to everyone playing with this mod!

Downloads.Description: Fixed 3 bugs, added a signage to let users to find the farm easily.
